entities.name: big bare elm reaching west over the grove
entities.what: Big bare elm-like tree (form elm_claw) with one dark, slightly twisted trunk rising from the north bank of the stream; at about two-thirds of its height it divides into an upright limb and long low limbs that reach far west over the slender grove behind it, all ending in dark crab-claw twigs with knobbly buds; no leaves.
entities.vis: part: foot lost in the bank's wash strokes; crown overlaps the twin elm's and the grove's
entities.src: sections.md S1: mist, sparse trees and water at the very start (≈ 35000–37610)
entities.note: Trunk outlines at u 35857-35873 and 35893-35903 from v 800 to 1000; below v 1000 it narrows down-left to where it meets the bank strokes at about (35832-35848, 1107-1123), so the foot is est; dark root or bank strokes at 35798-35823, v 1123-1148. Divides at about (35866, 651). crown_w: the westmost crab-claw twigs (35540-35580, v 520-580) at the end of a long dark limb from (35850, 660); a lower limb reaches 35560-35650 at v 780-850. Its top is est: the twigs over its upright limb (35850-35920, v 450-520) mix with the arched limb of S1.tree.bare_elm_twin_35920. Painted height about 665 px. The restyle draws it as a willow trunk with weeping strands; the strokes are bare.

entities.name: big twin-stemmed bare elm on the stream bank
entities.what: Big bare elm-like tree (form elm_claw) with two stems from one gnarled, knotted foot on the north bank of the stream (two dark knot-holes on the lower trunk): the west stem rises straight and bends over in a great arched limb; the east stem leans steeply north-east and crosses the trunk of the tall tree beside it; dark crab-claw twigs, no leaves.
entities.src: sections.md S1: mist, sparse trees and water at the very start (≈ 35000–37610)
entities.note: Foot between the trunk's outlines at (35905, 1197) and (35930, 1197) (bottom at v 1184-1213). Knots at (35976, 1074) and (35955, 1131). West stem: u 35966-36001 at v 790-1056, then curving west to (35905-35940, 650), arching limb with its apex at (35986-36036, 444), twigs to v about 405 (top). East stem: from (35966, 1134) by (36016, 1027) and (36051, 949) to (36087, 849), where it crosses S1.tree.bare_elm_tall_36070's trunk. Beyond the crossing it is lost among that tree's limbs. Reading 1 (used): it rises as the thinner straight stem at u 36097-36113 (v 445-740) beside the tall trunk, ending in twigs at v about 390. Reading 2: it bends upright and becomes the tall trunk itself (then this tree's top is about (36115, 290) and the tall tree's own trunk ends at the crossing). Read as one tree because both stems leave one knotted foot; two trees with touching feet is possible (the restyle draws two). Painted height about 795 px. SUPPORT: its foot is on the face of the stream's west bank (structures_e's S1.grd.bank_36060 / bank_35200's east end): bank top about v 1150-1178 above it, the bank's foot and the water about v 1240-1255 below it; its roots spread on the bank (35850-36000, v 1180-1230).

entities.name: tall straight bare tree at the bridge's west end
entities.what: Tall bare tree with a straight, slender dark trunk standing at the edge of the stream just west of the small bridge; it rises almost vertically, leaning slightly east, and forks near the top into a spreading head of crab-claw twigs, the highest crown of the three bare trees here (form elm_claw on a slender trunk); no leaves.
entities.vis: part: crossed by the twin elm's east stem at v 850-950
entities.src: sections.md S1: mist, sparse trees and water at the very start (≈ 35000–37610)
entities.note: Trunk u 36062-36094 at v 990-1150 (its outlines end at v 1131 and 1177); 36080-36095 at v 800-1000; 36106-36127 at v 620-794; 36125-36153 at v 413-750; fork at (36113, 380); twig tips at v 287-300 between u 36052 and 36240. The east stem of S1.tree.bare_elm_twin_35920 crosses it at v 850-950 (see that tree for the other reading, in which this trunk ends at the crossing and the tall upper trunk is the twin's). A bank line runs from its foot west to (35988, 1118). The small bridge's deck (structures_e's) starts just east of its foot. Painted height about 880 px. SUPPORT: the foot stands at the foot of the stream's west bank, at the waterline: structures_e's S1.water.stream_36500 shore_n passes (36075, 1180) and S1.grd.bank_36060's top is at (36080, 1062), about 110 px above; so its foot is at about the stream's level (H about -0.7 m) with its lower trunk against the bank face, or its roots run down the bank.

entities.name: slender far tree, west end of the grove
entities.what: Tall slender tree of the grove behind the bare elms (seven such trunks counted): a slender pale trunk, bare for most of its height, ending in a fan-shaped head of fine rising shoots (between trees/types.md `slender_3`, a young willow with a small head of rising shoots, and `willow_fan`'s far crowns); painted in pale ink (distant), early-spring bare.
entities.vis: part: lower trunk faint in the wash
entities.src: sections.md S1: mist, sparse trees and water at the very start (≈ 35000–37610)
entities.note: The broadest and palest trunk of the grove, outlines at u 35447 and 35493 from v 427 to 660, darker at 35487-35520 by v 660-760; its foot is lost in the dark wash, est at the grove's foot line. t6's reading (its report): this trunk leans on down to a foot at about (35525, 890), taking the dark diagonal wash band 35450-35560, v 770-860 for its lower trunk; here that band is read as a slope in front of the grove (its lower edge is a sharp line at v 850-860, and no trunk outline crosses it). Crown the largest of the grove, its fan spray rising to (35446, 130); its pale fans run west to about (35262, 290) (t6 reads the same crown as 35260-35560, v 125-560) and meet the shoots of t6's S1.tree.willow_pollard_35128 (crown_e 35442, 590). Painted height about 610 px. The restyle paints these as green weeping willows; the strokes show rising fans, not hanging strands. MERGE: t7's foot line is kept: on the merge's grey zoom-2 crop (grove_feet_grey.jpg) the trunks thicken and end at v ~730-770 on the top of a dark diagonal wash band, now S1.grd.bank_35530, and no trunk outline crosses the band; t6's lower feet (v 890-915) are declined.
